§ 01The problem

Your agent works in a demo. Production is the hard part.

Production agents need durable execution, scoped security, human approvals, managed state, audit trails and usage controls. Without that infrastructure, agents break, leak access or run out of control when they touch real systems.

01

Long-running work breaks

Agent jobs need to survive crashes, deploys and sessions that last hours or days.

02

Tool access becomes a security problem

Agents need credentials and access to real systems without getting unrestricted access to everything.

03

Risky actions need control

Production agents need approvals, scoped permissions and a complete record of what happened.

04

Costs become hard to control

Once agents reach real users, teams need usage limits, metering and visibility into consumption.

05

Infrastructure gets rebuilt per agent

Every new agent should not require another custom stack for execution, state, security and governance.

OpenGeni provides that layer once. Your teams build the agents.

§ 06Production controls

Built for agents that touch real systems.

approvals

Controlled execution

Sensitive actions can require human approval.

isolation

Scoped environments

Run agent work inside isolated, session-specific environments.

durability

Durable by default

Long-running work survives restarts and continues from recorded state.

audit

Auditable

Agent actions and execution history are recorded instead of disappearing into a chat session.
